title: Zesty Shrimp Ceviche
description: A refreshing shrimp ceviche marinated in zesty lime juice, mixed with diced tomatoes, onions, and fresh cilantro. Garnished with avocado slices and served chilled, this vibrant dish brings coastal flavors to life.

title: Grilled Tuna Steak with Citrus Salsa
description: A perfectly grilled tuna steak topped with a tangy citrus salsa made from oranges, lime, and fresh herbs. This dish is balanced and full of bright flavors, perfect for a satisfying meal.

title: Classic Lobster Bisque
description: A rich, creamy lobster bisque that combines smooth textures with the intense flavors of fresh lobster, sherry, and herbs. This luxurious soup is perfect for a special occasion or elegant dinner.

title: Smoked Salmon Platter with Dill Cream
description: A beautifully arranged smoked salmon platter accompanied by a dill cream sauce, capers, red onions, and lemon wedges. Served with toasted baguette slices, this dish is perfect for brunch or a light appetizer.

title: Spicy Fish Tacos with Avocado Slaw
description: Crispy battered fish fillets served in warm tortillas, topped with a zesty avocado slaw and a sprinkle of fresh cilantro. These tacos pack a flavorful punch and are perfect for seafood lovers.

title: Garlic Butter Scallops with Asparagus
description: Succulent scallops seared in a garlic butter sauce, served with tender asparagus. This simple yet indulgent dish highlights the delicate flavors of fresh scallops and is perfect for a gourmet meal.

title: Creamy Clam Chowder
description: A hearty bowl of classic New England clam chowder, filled with tender clams, potatoes, and celery in a creamy broth. This comforting soup is garnished with parsley and served with oyster crackers.

title: Spaghetti alle Vongole
description: A traditional Italian dish featuring spaghetti with fresh clams, garlic, and white wine, topped with parsley and a hint of red pepper flakes. This light yet flavorful pasta dish transports you to the Italian coast.

title: Pan-Seared Mahi-Mahi with Mango Salsa
description: A tropical dish featuring pan-seared mahi-mahi fillets topped with a fresh mango salsa, adding a sweet and tangy flavor. Paired with a side of coconut rice, this dish is a delightful blend of tropical and savory flavors.
